rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites promised that if God granted them bounty, they would give charity, maintain kinship, and become among the righteous, meaning believers in divine unity; hypocrites do not sincerely affirm unity.
rows.anchor: لئن آتانا من فضله لنصدقن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A client of Umar accidentally killed a hypocrite who was close to Hatib; the Prophet gave the victim's blood-money to Thalaba b. Hatib, whose relative had been killed, and God then provided Thalaba with bounty.
rows.anchor: مولى لعمر بن الخطاب قتل رجلا من المنافقين خطأ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God granted the hypocrites bounty, they withheld it and turned away in refusal.
rows.anchor: بخلوا به وتولوا وهم معرضون

words: فأعقبهم نفاقا في قلوبهم إلى يوم يلقونه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made hypocrisy settle in their hearts until the Resurrection because they broke their promise to God and used to lie about fulfilling it.
rows.anchor: فأعقبهم نفاقا في قلوبهم إلى يوم يلقونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The secret and private conversation refers to the plot agreed upon by the people of the Aqaba to kill the Prophet.
rows.anchor: الذي أجمعوا عليه من قتل النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Before the Tabuk campaign of hardship, the Prophet urged charity; Abd al-Rahman b. Awf gave 4,000 dirhams from his 8,000, keeping half for his household, and the Prophet blessed both portions.
rows.anchor: فجاء عبد الرحمن بن عوف الزهري بأربعة آلاف درهم

words: الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God blessed Abd al-Rahman b. Awf's wealth; when he died, his estate was valued at 180,000 for his two wives, 90,000 for each.
rows.anchor: حتى أنه يوم مات بلغ ثمن ماله لامرأتيه

words: الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Asim b. Adi of the Ansar brought seventy wasqs of dates, a camel-load, and scattered them among the charity donations, apologizing that the amount was small.
rows.anchor: وجاء عاصم بن عدي الأنصاري

words: الذين يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Aqil b. Qays earned two sa's by working all night in a palm grove, gave one sa' to charity, and kept one for his family so he could share in the donations.
rows.anchor: بت ليلتى أعمل في النخل أجر بالجرين على صاعين

words: يلمزون المطوعين من المؤمنين في الصدقات
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hypocrites called large donations ostentation and small ones unnecessary, saying their poor donors needed the money more; they accused Abd al-Rahman and Asim of showing off and dismissed Abu Aqil's sa'.
rows.anchor: كان هذا أفقر إلى ماله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the Bedouins came to Medina, the Prophet said not to sit with them or speak to them.
rows.anchor: النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم حين قدموا المدينة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bedouins are more deeply disbelieving and hypocritical and less likely than others to understand the revealed norms and practices in God's Book.
rows.anchor: هم أقل فهما بالسنن من غيرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some Bedouins regard their spending in God's cause as a loss they must pay, without expecting reward.
rows.anchor: كان نفقته غرم يغرمها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They await Muhammad's death so they can be rid of him and stop giving him their wealth; the verse was revealed about Bedouins of Muzayna.
rows.anchor: يموت فنستريح منه ولا نعطيه أموالنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God turns the evil they wished upon the believers back upon them, and He hears their speech and knows it.
rows.anchor: والله سميع } لمقالتهم، { عليم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Other Bedouins believe God is one with no partner and believe in resurrection and the recompense of deeds.
rows.anchor: يصدق بالله أنه واحد لا شريك له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They treat spending for God's cause and the Prophet's prayers as means of nearness to God; the Prophet's prayers mean his seeking forgiveness, and the wording places the parts in advance.
rows.anchor: يعني واستغفار النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The clarification means that this spending and seeking forgiveness truly bring them near to God; their reward is entry into His mercy, meaning Paradise, with forgiveness and mercy for them.
rows.anchor: سيدخلهم الله في رحمته } ، يعني جنته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse about believing Bedouins was revealed concerning Muqarrin al-Muzani.
rows.anchor: ، نزلت في مقرن المزني

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earliest forerunners are the earliest Muslims among the Emigrants and Helpers who prayed toward both qiblas; Muqatil identifies Ali b. Abi Talib and ten men of Badr.
rows.anchor: الذين صلوا إلى القبلتين، علي بن أبي طالب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who follow the forerunners well follow their religion, Islam; God is pleased with their obedience, and they are pleased with the reward.
rows.anchor: على دينهم الإسلام، { بإحسان رضي الله عنهم } بالطاعة

words: جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their reward is gardens with rivers below, where they remain forever and never die; this is the great success.
rows.anchor: يعني بساتين تجرى تحتها الأنهار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their good deed was campaigning with the Prophet before Tabuk; their bad deed was staying behind from the Tabuk campaign without permission.
rows.anchor: يعني غزاة قبل غزاة تبوك مع النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The occasion involved three Ansar: Abu Lubaba, named Marwan b. Abd al-Mundhir, Aws b. Hizam, and Wadi'a b. Thalaba, who heard the Prophet was returning from Tabuk and tied themselves to mosque pillars in remorse.
rows.anchor: نزلت في أبي لبابة، اسمه مروان بن عبد المنذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They vowed not to release themselves until the Prophet released them; when told who they were, he vowed not to release them until commanded and not to excuse them until God did.
rows.anchor: وأقسموا ألا يحلو أنفسهم حتى يحلهم النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil says that when God says perhaps, it is a certain promise; after this verse came down, the Prophet released them and they returned home.
rows.anchor: قال مقاتل: العسى من الله واجب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The three men later brought the wealth that had kept them from joining the campaign and asked the Prophet to give it in charity; he disliked taking it, so the command to take it was revealed.
rows.anchor: ثم جاءوا بأموالهم إلى النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: خذ من أموالهم صدقة تطهرهم وتزكيهم بها
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God commands the Prophet to take their alms to cleanse them of their staying behind and improve them through it.
rows.anchor: خذ من أموالهم صدقة تطهرهم } من تخلفهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Praying for them means asking God to forgive them; the Prophet's prayer settles and reassures their hearts.
rows.anchor: يعني إن استغفارك لهم سكن لقلوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God hears their request that the Prophet take their wealth as charity and knows what they said.
rows.anchor: عليم } [آية: 103]. بما قالوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of Hud say he brought no clear proof that God had sent him to them.
rows.anchor: يعني ببيان أنك رسول إلينا من الله

words: وما نحن بتاركي آلهتنا عن قولك
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They mean they will not stop worshipping idols merely because Hud says so, and they will not believe that he is a messenger.
rows.anchor: ما نحن بتاركي آلهتنا عن قولك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They claim one of their idols afflicted Hud with madness or mental impairment, and say they do not want him harmed, so he should avoid the idols and remain safe.
rows.anchor: ولا نحب أن يصيبك أو يعتريك ذلك فاجتنبها سالما

rows.speaker: الفراء
rows.claim: Abdullah reports al-Farra's distinction: الخبل with a still bāʾ is an illness that prevents movement and disables the body, while الخبل with a vowel on bāʾ means madness.
rows.anchor: قال عبد الله: قال الفراء: الخبل مسكنة الباء

words: إني أشهد الله وأشهدوا أني بريء مما تشركون
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud calls God and the people to witness that he disavows the things they associate with God.
rows.anchor: قال إني أشهد الله واشهدوا أني بريء مما تشركون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase refers to the gods worshipped besides God.
rows.anchor: { من دونه } من الآلهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud challenges them and their gods together to plot against him without giving him any respite.
rows.anchor: فكيدوني جميعا } أنتم والآلهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hud says he trusts God in response to their threat that their idols will harm him.
rows.anchor: ربي وربكم } حين خوفوه آلهتهم أنها تصيبه

words: ما من دابة إلا هو آخذ بناصيتها
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: دابة means any creature or thing, and God taking its forelock means that He causes it to die.
rows.anchor: يعني ما من شيء، { إلا } و { هو آخذ بناصيتها }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God being on a straight path means that He is upon the truth.
rows.anchor: إن ربي على صراط مستقيم

words: فإن تولوا فقد أبلغتكم ما أرسلت به إليكم
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If they turn away from belief, Hud has delivered his message that punishment will descend upon them in this world.
rows.anchor: يعني فإن تعرضوا عن الإيمان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After their destruction, God will replace them with a people better and more obedient to Him.
rows.anchor: أمثل وأطوع لله منكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They do not diminish anything from God's dominion by rejecting Him; they only diminish themselves, and God preserves all their deeds.
rows.anchor: ولا تنقصونه من ملكه شيئا، إنما تنقصون أنفسكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's command means His decree that punishment descend.
rows.anchor: يعني قولنا في نزول العذاب

words: نجينا هودا والذين آمنوا معه برحمة منا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God saved Hud and the believers from the punishment by a blessing He bestowed upon them.
rows.anchor: برحمة منا } ، يعني بنعمة منا عليهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The severe punishment was a cold wind that did not let up until it destroyed them.
rows.anchor: وهي الريح الباردة لم تفتر عنهم حتى أهلكتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means that the people of Thamud seemed never to have lived in this world.
rows.anchor: كأنهم لم يكونوا في الدنيا قط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thamud disbelieved in the oneness of their Lord, and the prayer that they be far away refers to their destruction.
rows.anchor: ألا إن ثمود كفروا } بتوحيد { ربهم ألا بعدا لثمود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Midyan was a son of Abraham, and Shuayb was son of Nuwayb, son of Midyan, son of Abraham.
rows.anchor: وهو ابن إباراهيم خليل الرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent Shuayb to Midyan; calling him their brother describes kinship, not shared religion.
rows.anchor: يعني أرسلنا، { أخاهم شعيبا } ، وليس بأخيهم في الدين

words: اعبدوا الله ما لكم من إله غيره
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship God means affirm His oneness; they have no lord other than Him.
rows.anchor: يعني وحدوا الله، { ما لكم من إله غيره }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb forbids short measure and weight when they measure and weigh; they are prosperous and blessed, yet he fears worldly punishment that will encompass them all.
rows.anchor: ولا تنقصوا المكيال والميزان } إذا كلتم ووزنتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The encompassing day means punishment surrounded them so completely that none escaped.
rows.anchor: يعني أحاط بهم العذاب، فلم ينج منهم أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must give full measure and weight justly and must not diminish people's rights.
rows.anchor: أوفوا المكيال والميزان بالقسط } ، يعني بالعدل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Making corruption in the land means committing sins, especially by reducing measures and weights.
rows.anchor: يقول: لا تعملوا فيها المعاصي، يعني بالفساد نقصان الكيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's remaining reward in the Hereafter is better for believers than cheating on measures and weights; it lasts, as in the verse saying what is with God remains.
rows.anchor: خير لكم إن كنتم مؤمنين } ، يعني لو كنتم مؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb is not a watcher over their deeds; God is the One who guards their deeds.
rows.anchor: يعني على أعمالكم { بحفيظ } [آية: 86]، يعني برقيب

words: أصلواتك تأمرك أن نترك ما يعبد آباؤنا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people mock Shuayb, asking if his prayers command them to abandon the idols their fathers worshipped.
rows.anchor: أصلواتك تأمرك أن نترك } ، يعني أن نعتزل

words: أو أن نفعل في أموالنا ما نشاء
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They claim they may do as they wish with their money, either reducing measures and weights or giving full measure.
rows.anchor: أو أن نفعل في أموالنا ما نشاء } ، يعنون إن شئنا نقصنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In mockery, they call Shuayb a fool by saying patient and rightly guided, meaning foolish and astray.
rows.anchor: إنك لأنت الحليم } ، يعنون السفيه

words: إن كنت على بينة من ربي ورزقني منه رزقا حسنا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb's good provision from God means faith, which is guidance.
rows.anchor: قال يقوم أرأيتم إن كنت على بينة من ربي ورزقني منه رزقا حسنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb says he does not intend to forbid something and then do it himself, answering their demand that he return to their religion.
rows.anchor: يعني وما أريد أن أنهاكم عن أمر،

words: إن أريد إلا الإصلاح ما استطعت
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb wants only as much reform as he can accomplish, and his success in doing good comes only from God.
rows.anchor: يعني ما أريد { إلا الإصلاح ما استطعت وما توفيقي } في الإصلاح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shuayb trusts in God despite the threat to expel him and the believers, and says that the return after death is to God.
rows.anchor: لنخرجنك يشعيب والذين آمنوا معك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true invocation means the declaration of sincerity and divine unity.
rows.anchor: له دعوة الحق } ، يعني كلمة الإخلاص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those invoked besides God are the idols that people worship.
rows.anchor: يعني والذين يعبدون من دون الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idols neither answer their worshippers nor benefit them, like water that a thirsty man at a well's edge calls toward his mouth but cannot reach, until he dies of thirst.
rows.anchor: كما لا ينفع العطشان الماء يبسط يده إلى الماء

words: وما دعاء الكافرين إلا في ضلال
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling the idols means worshipping them, and the worship of disbelievers is loss and falsehood.
rows.anchor: فادعوا، يعني فادعوا الأصنام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those in the heavens who prostrate to God are the angels; those on earth who do so willingly are the believers.
rows.anchor: يعني الملائكة، { والأرض طوعا } ، يعني المؤمنين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if disbelievers hate it, their shadows prostrate to God at sunrise and in the afternoon when the sun passes its zenith.
rows.anchor: ظل الكافر كرها يسجد لله، وهو

words: قل من رب السماوات والأرض قل الله
rows.speaker: أبي بن كعب، ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ubayy b. Kab and Ibn Masud read قالوا الله, they said God, in place of قل الله, say God.
rows.anchor: في قراءة أبي بن كعب، وابن مسعود: قالوا الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The protectors taken besides God are idols that people worship, though they cannot secure benefit or harm even for themselves.
rows.anchor: قل أفاتخذتم من دونه } الله { أولياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The blind person is blind to guidance and represents the disbeliever; the seeing person has guidance and represents the believer.
rows.anchor: الأعمى } عن الهدى، { والبصير } بالهدى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Darkness represents associationism and light represents faith; one who is in darkness is not equal to one in light.
rows.anchor: يعني الشرك، { والنور } ، يعني الإيمان

words: أم جعلوا لله شركاء خلقوا كخلقه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The question asks whether they describe partners as creators like God, making creation seem alike to them; idols cannot create, so they cannot merit worship.
rows.anchor: يعني وصفوا { لله شركاء } من الآلهة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The creations would only seem alike if the idols created as God does, but they cannot create, own, or act as God does.
rows.anchor: فإنهم لا يقدرون أن يخلقوا

words: قل الله خالق كل شيء وهو الواحد القهار
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God alone creates everything and is one without partner; the idols are subdued and abject.
rows.anchor: الله خالق كل شيء وهو الواحد } ، لا شريك له

words: أنزل من السماء ماء فسالت أودية بقدرها
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The parable contrasts disbelief and faith, truth and falsehood: rainwater represents the Quran taught to believers and abandoned by disbelievers; valleys carry water according to their size.
rows.anchor: ضرب الله مثل الكفر والإيمان، ومثل الحق والباطل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The flood carries foam that rises high.
rows.anchor: فاحتمل السيل } ، يعني سيل الماء، { زبدا رابيا } ، يعني عاليا

words: ومما يوقدون عليه في النار ابتغاء حلية أو متاع
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The jewelry sought from fire is gold and silver; utensils and goods include brass, iron, and lead, which also produce foam when heated.
rows.anchor: ابتغاء حلية } ، يعني الذهب، والفضة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Foam from the flood is useless, and heating jewelry or goods expels the useless impurities while the useful metals remain.
rows.anchor: فالسيل زبد لا ينتفع به، والحلي والمتاع له أيضا زبد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Water represents Quranic truth, valleys hearts, and the flood desires; useful water and purified metal represent truth that benefits its people in the Hereafter, while foam and slag represent useless falsehood.
rows.anchor: ومثل الماء مثل القرآن، وهو الحق، ومثل الأودية مثل القلوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jufāʾ means dried up and useless, like foam that benefits people not at all.
rows.anchor: يعني يابسا لا ينتفع به الناس كما لا ينتفع بالسيل

words: وأما ما ينفع الناس فيمكث في الأرض
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Useful water remains for drinking and irrigation, just as useful truth remains and benefits its people; God sets forth likenesses in these three examples together.
rows.anchor: فيستقون ويزرعون عليه وينتفعون به، يقول: { كذلك يضرب الله الأمثال }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil glosses those who respond as responding in faith and identifies their good reward in the Hereafter as Paradise.
rows.anchor: للذين استجابوا } بالإيمان وهم الكفار

words: لو أن لهم ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if they possessed everything on earth and as much again, they would offer it to ransom themselves from punishment.
rows.anchor: لو أن لهم ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their account is severe, with none of their sins passed over; their destination is Hell, a miserable resting place they prepared for themselves.
rows.anchor: يعني شدة الحساب حين لا يتجاوز عن شيء من ذنوبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people of the city rejoiced at the men entering Lot's house.
rows.anchor: وجاء أهل المدينة يستبشرون } [آية: 67] بدخول الرجال منزل لوط

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot saw the visitors as men and appealed to the townspeople not to disgrace him through his guests.
rows.anchor: ولوط، عليه السلام، يرى أنهم رجال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot asks them to fear God and not humiliate him concerning the guests.
rows.anchor: واتقوا الله ولا تخزون } [آية: 69] فيهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They say they had forbidden Lot to host anyone; he warned them because they assaulted guests sexually, and out of shame offered his two daughters in marriage, named Raytha and Zaghutha.
rows.anchor: أن تضيف منهم أحدا؛ لأن لوطا كان يحذرهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Lot tells them that if they insist on acting, they should marry his daughters.
rows.anchor: هؤلاء بناتي إن كنتم فاعلين } [آية: 71] لا بد فتزوجوهن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The expression la-amruka is an Arabic idiom.
rows.anchor: لعمرك } ، كلمة من كلام العرب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They wander confused in their misguidance.
rows.anchor: إنهم لفي سكرتهم يعمهون } [آية: 72]، يعني لفي ضلالتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cry was Gabriel's cry, and it struck them at sunrise.
rows.anchor: يعني صيحة جبريل، عليه السلام، { مشرقين } [آية: 73] يعني حين طلعت الشمس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God created the heavens and earth for a real purpose, not in vain; exalted means elevated above what they associate with Him.
rows.anchor: لم يخلقهما باطلا لغير شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The human created from a sperm drop is Ubayy b. Khalaf al-Jumahi, whom the Prophet killed at Uhud.
rows.anchor: يعني أبي بن خلف الجمحي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ubayy challenged the Prophet about how God could resurrect bones, crushing and scattering them in the wind; the same challenge appears in 36:78.
rows.anchor: وجعل يفتها ويذريها في الريح، نظيرها في آخر يس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The cattle are camels, cows, and sheep.
rows.anchor: والأنعام } ، يعني الإبل، والبقر، والغنم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their wool, camel hair, and other hair provide warmth and household furnishings; their backs and milk provide benefits, and their meat is eaten.
rows.anchor: ما تستدفئون بها من أصوافها، وأوبارها، وأشعارها أثاثا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who associate partners with God are the disbelievers of Mecca.
rows.anchor: وقال الذين أشركوا } مع الله غيره، يعني كفار مكة

words: لو شاء الله ما عبدنا من دونه من شيء
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They argue that, had God willed, neither they nor their ancestors would have worshipped idols or prohibited crops and livestock; they falsely claim God ordered the prohibitions.
rows.anchor: نحن ولا آباؤنا ولا حرمنا من دونه من شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earlier nations acted similarly, denying their messengers and prohibiting what God had made lawful in crops and livestock, just as Mecca's disbelievers do.
rows.anchor: يعني هكذا { فعل الذين من قبلهم } من الأمم الخالية برسلهم

words: فهل على الرسل إلا البلاغ المبين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A messenger's only duty is to convey and explain clearly that God did not prohibit crops and livestock.
rows.anchor: ما على الرسول إلا أن يبلغ ويبين لكم

words: ولقد بعثنا في كل أمة رسولا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Every community received a messenger calling people to worship and affirm God's oneness and to avoid the worship of idols.
rows.anchor: يعني أن وحدوا الله، { واجتنبوا الطاغوت }

words: فمنهم من هدى الله ومنهم من حقت عليه الضلالة
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guided some to His religion, while misguidance became due for others; the latter were punished in this world, as the land's remains show.
rows.anchor: فمنهم من هدى الله } إلى دينه

words: فسيروا في الأرض فانظروا كيف كان عاقبة المكذبين
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to travel and see warns Mecca's disbelievers to avoid the punishment that befell earlier communities who denied their messengers.
rows.anchor: رسلهم بالعذاب الذين حقت عليهم الضلالة في الدنيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if Muhammad earnestly desires their guidance, God does not guide one whom He leads astray; such a person has no guide or defender from punishment.
rows.anchor: فإن الله لا يهدي } إلى دينه، { من يضل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Mecca's disbelievers asked the Prophet when the Hour would come, God revealed that the unseen of the heavens and earth, including the Hour, belongs to Him alone and no servant knows it.
rows.anchor: وذلك أن كفار مكة سألوا النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: وما أمر الساعة إلا كلمح البصر أو هو أقرب
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour's affair means the Resurrection; it comes as quickly as an eye's blink, or faster than a blink.
rows.anchor: وما أمر الساعة } ، يعني أمر تأتي، يعني البعث

words: إن الله على كل شيء قدير
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is capable of the Resurrection and of everything else.
rows.anchor: إن الله على كل شيء } من البعث وغيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People are born knowing nothing, and God subsequently teaches them.
rows.anchor: لا تعلمون شيئا } ، فعلمكم بعد ذلك الجهل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hearts are what is meant by the faculties called afʾida.
rows.anchor: وجعل لكم السمع والأبصار والأفئدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They should thank the Lord for these blessings of fine creation by affirming His oneness.
rows.anchor: رب هذه النعم تعالى ذكره في حسن خلقكم فتوحدونه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God chose Moses as a messenger and tells him to listen to what is revealed to him, namely God's declaration of His oneness.
rows.anchor: يا موسى للرسالة { فاستمع لما يوحى

rows.speaker: كعب
rows.claim: Ka'b reports that God spoke to Moses twice, Muhammad saw his Lord twice, and Adam disobeyed his Lord twice; Muqatil gives no grading.
rows.anchor: عن كعب: أن موسى، عليه السلام، كلمه ربه مرتين

rows.speaker: عبد الحميد بن يوسف
rows.claim: Abd al-Hamid b. Yusuf says the cry of a partridge is the words The Merciful rose over the Throne; Muqatil gives no grading.
rows.anchor: عن عبد الحميد بن يوسف، قال صياح الدراج

rows.speaker: الحسن
rows.claim: Al-Hasan interprets the words as I almost hide it from Myself; Hadil says he did not hear this from Muqatil.
rows.anchor: قال: أخفيها من نفسي، قال هذيل: ولم أسمع مقاتلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship Me means affirm My oneness, since there is no god with Me.
rows.anchor: فاعبدني } يعني فوحدني، فإنه ليس معي إله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses is to establish prayer in order to remember God.
rows.anchor: وأقم الصلاة لذكري } [آية: 14] يقول: لتذكرني بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hour is certainly coming, so that every righteous and wicked soul will be recompensed according to what it did in worldly life.
rows.anchor: يقول: إن الساعة جائية لا بد { أكاد أخفيها } من نفسي

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud reads the phrase with from Myself; Muqatil argues that if God nearly hides the Hour from Himself, no creature could know it.
rows.anchor: أكاد أخفيها } من نفسي في قراءة ابن مسعود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh has disobeyed; Moses is to call him to worship God, though God has bound Pharaoh's heart so that he will not believe.
rows.anchor: يقول: إنه عصى، فادعوه إلى عبادتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A keeper angel from the storehouses of the wind came to Moses and told him to go and carry out the command.
rows.anchor: فأتاه ملك خازن من خزان الريح

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses' request to have his chest expanded means that his heart be made wide.
rows.anchor: رب اشرح لي صدري } [آية: 25] يقول: أوسع لي قلبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The angel urges Moses to go as commanded, saying even Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil could not accomplish this task.
rows.anchor: فإن هذا قد عجز عنه جبريل، وميكائيل، وإسرافيل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks that his task of conveying the message to Pharaoh and his people be made easy rather than difficult.
rows.anchor: وهو على ما أمرتني به من البلاغ إلى فرعون وقومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses had a stammer or heaviness in his tongue; the source attributes this explanation to Muhammad b. Hani.
rows.anchor: وكان فى لسانه رته يعنى الثقل، هذا الحرف عن محمد بن هانىء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means that they understand Moses' speech.
rows.anchor: يفقهوا قولي } [آية: 28] يعنى كلامى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses asks for a helper from his family to accompany him in approaching Pharaoh so Pharaoh will believe him.
rows.anchor: يقول: بالدخول إلى فرعون، يعنى عونا { من أهلي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God specially chose Moses as His messenger when Moses was forty years old.
rows.anchor: واصطنعتك لنفسي } [آية: 41] وهو ابن أربعين سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The signs are the hand and staff; Aaron was in Egypt, and the brothers met before reaching Pharaoh.
rows.anchor: هارون { بآياتي } يعنى اليد والعصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They must not weaken in God's cause or in delivering the message to Pharaoh, which emboldens them to face him.
rows.anchor: يقول: ولا تضعفا فى أمرى، فى قراءة ابن مسعود

rows.speaker: ابن مسعود
rows.claim: Ibn Masud reads the phrase as do not weaken in My remembrance in delivering to Pharaoh.
rows.anchor: فى قراءة ابن مسعود: " ولا تهنا فى ذكرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pharaoh had disobeyed God for four hundred years.
rows.anchor: يقول: عصى الله، عز وجل، أربعمائة سنة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gentle speech means addressing Pharaoh respectfully by his kunya and inviting him to purify himself and follow his Lord so he may fear God.
rows.anchor: يقول: ادعواه الكنية، يعنى بالقول اللين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The gentle invitation gives Pharaoh the opportunity to remember or fear God.
rows.anchor: لعله يتذكر أو يخشى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses and Aaron fear Pharaoh will hasten to kill them or become obstinate.
rows.anchor: قالا ربنا إننا نخاف أن يفرط علينا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God tells Moses and Aaron not to fear being killed because He is with them to defend them, as stated in 28:35.
rows.anchor: إنني معكما } فى الدفع عنكما، فذلك قوله سبحانه: فلا يصلون إليكما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: I hear means God hears Pharaoh's reply, and I see means God knows what he says.
rows.anchor: أسمع } جواب فرعون { وأرى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muqatil compares God's seeing here with the wording in 4:105, where what God shows means what He makes known.
rows.anchor: وأرى } [آية: 46] يقول: وأعلم ما يقول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's speech to Moses ends here; when the brothers reach Pharaoh, Moses tells him to send the Israelites with them and not enslave them through forced labor.
rows.anchor: فانقطع كلام الله عز وجل لموسى، عليه السلام، فلما أتيا فرعون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With us means Moses and Aaron, and not torment them means not subjecting the Israelites to forced labor.
rows.anchor: فأرسل معنا بني إسرائيل ولا تعذبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign from God is a token, namely the hand and the staff.
rows.anchor: يعني بعلامة { من ربك } وهي اليد والعصا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Peace is upon whoever follows guidance by believing in God.
rows.anchor: والسلام على من اتبع الهدى } [آية: 47] يقول: والسلام على من آمن بالله
